Predicates 1-6 trace to their records: the SI1 spec holds before/after route matrices with validate and check rows and a flat-file plus fabricated-include cell set (T5), and the record claims exit 3 with flattening:re-entry and the conditional unattended:flat-without-root diagnostic; SI2 binds delegated reading C with the 436-model identity digest unchanged; SI3 records 17 deltas with 8-to-0 and 5-to-0 counts, oracle passes and the round trip; SI4 and the remote receipt bind the annotated tag object peeling to merge 9c051d52. The lane receipts sum consistently (initial 22,146 passes with the three red checks disclosed; corrected 22,149, all six shard exits 0, uv 0.10.10), and the merge-versus-tested-tree difference is characterized in the tag receipt as two induction-skill planning paths plus a 226-test merged-checkout gate. Plan section 12 amendments preserve the approved predicates while recording the D1 and C2 corrections, and the question sweep disposes every row with evidence or a named maintenance target.
